title: Deposition: fall from a warehouse ladder

exchanges.q: Can you please state your full name for the record?
Where were you working in May 2024?
exchanges.a: At a warehouse in {CITY}, for the company {COMPANY}. I loaded trucks.

exchanges.q: How many hours did you work per week?
exchanges.a: Usually fifty hours. In May it was more, about sixty, because of the holidays.

a: I was on a ladder, about eight feet high, taking boxes from a shelf.
The ladder moved, and I fell on my back. My left arm hit the floor.

exchanges.q: Had you received any training on that ladder?
exchanges.a: No. Nobody trained me. My supervisor only showed me where the ladders were.

exchanges.q: Did you tell your supervisor that the ladder was broken?
exchanges.a: Yes, I told him two days before. He said that he would order a new one.
I broke my left wrist, and I hurt my lower back. I still have pain when I lift more than ten pounds.

exchanges.q: How long were you unable to work?
exchanges.a: Four months. I returned in September, but only part-time.
My coworker {COWORKER} saw it. He called the manager, and the manager called an ambulance.

exchanges.q: Have you ever been injured at work before?
exchanges.a: Once, in 2019, I cut my hand, but it was minor. I did not miss any work.
